name: clausum
description: SaaS de análisis de contratos con IA

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n web,emu -c blue,green "node scripts/wait-for-functions-emulator.mjs && pnpm dev" "pnpm dev:emulators"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @clausum/shared build && pnpm --filter @clausum/web build && pnpm --filter @clausum/functions build
scripts.deploy:hosting: pnpm build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting --config backend/firebase/firebase.json
scripts.deploy:functions: pnpm build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions --config backend/firebase/firebase.json
